generatedFrom: data/maps/map_groups.json (gMapGroup_TownsAndRoutes / gMapGroup_Dungeons / gMapGroup_SpecialArea - the real glow-vs-marker distinction from src/pokedex_area_screen.c)
notes: x/y (and rectX/Y/W/H for glow entries) are pixel coordinates/dimensions on the bundled 128x128 johto_region_map.png.

Computed by proportionally scaling the real 28x15 MAPSEC grid cell (or bounding rect, for multi-cell sections) onto the 128x128 image - the exact native-GBA pixel offset used by the live in-game area-screen renderer for this specific flattened map export was not confirmed, so this is a proportional approximation of real grid data, not a bit-exact reproduction.

type=glow (towns/routes, real area_glow.png colors) vs type=marker (dungeons/special areas, real area_marker.png sprite) mirrors the real game's own two different indicator systems - see the comment block at the top of src/pokedex_area_screen.c.
A species can have multiple entries (found in multiple areas).
